$comment: Deterministic routing fixtures. CI asserts that published guidance carries the signal each scenario depends on; no external model is involved.

scenarios.request: What does src/services/user.ts export and what are the method signatures?
scenarios.rationale: A declaration view answers the question without reading implementations.

scenarios.request: Which local files does src/index.ts pull in before I start refactoring?
scenarios.rationale: Bounded local relationships from one entry file are exactly the graph tool.

scenarios.request: Give me an overview of the auth module starting at src/auth/index.ts.
scenarios.rationale: Use the graph to find the local files, then a skeleton per file, before reading bodies.

scenarios.request: Show me the complete body of the retryWithBackoff function.
scenarios.rationale: Bodies are always removed; a file-reading tool must supply the implementation.

scenarios.request: What is the return type of the untyped helper in lib/helper.js?
scenarios.rationale: The skeleton answers it, but an unresolved type is reported as unknown with a warning rather than guessed.

scenarios.request: How does the express router implement route matching?
scenarios.rationale: Packages are reported as external and never traversed or read.

scenarios.request: What value does CONFIG_TIMEOUT hold at runtime and what side effects does init() cause?
scenarios.rationale: Values and side effects require execution or file reading; this server never evaluates code.
Absolute paths and traversal outside the workspace root are refused.
guidanceSignals: relative to the server workspace root

scenarios.request: Summarize a file that currently has a syntax error.
scenarios.rationale: The tool still answers, but diagnostics and complete=false must be reported rather than presented as a full view.

scenarios.request: Map every local dependency of a very large entry file.
scenarios.rationale: The traversal is bounded; truncation, limitsReached, and untraversed edges must be surfaced.

scenarios.request: Install the missing dependency and rewrite src/index.ts to fix the build.
scenarios.rationale: The server is read-only; it never writes, executes, or installs anything.
